manifest.title: Review CPU request
manifest.purpose: Compare observed CPU usage with the admitted request, then independently evaluate a policy-bounded reduction.

baseline: Complete fresh scoped Azure, Kubernetes and Prometheus receipts
Exact cluster/workload identity and declared direct or approved replica-envelope usage
Observed positive admitted CPU request and qualified P95 usage
Configured observation duration, coverage, freshness and resolution
guarded: All baseline evidence, qualified P99/observed peaks, throttling and OOM history
Known compatible autoscalers and no observed OOM or workload eviction veto
Owner-reviewed window, disruption policy, environment, minimum, headroom and reduction bounds

limitations: Low CPU usage is not a safe reduction target or proof a node can be removed.
Requests are not CPU limits; a request ratio is not saturation.
Current identities cannot reconstruct missing history or deleted membership.
Replica-envelope statistics are conservative per-replica values, not workload-total percentiles.
Returned evaluation-point coverage is not raw scrape completeness.
prerequisites: Confirm the metric window contains peak and business-critical periods.
Review P99 usage, throttling, startup and failover behavior.
risks: Historical usage might not represent future peaks.
Lower requests can change placement and noisy-neighbor behavior.
validation: Run VPA in Off mode and compare recommendations.
Canary an independently approved request change and verify SLOs under load.
rollback: Restore the previous CPU request of __current_cpu_request__ mCPU in source configuration through the owning delivery pipeline.
Stop promotion if SLOs, throttling, OOM or restarts regress; remeasure before proposing another change.
baseline_rollback: No numeric change is proposed; do not apply a baseline investigation.

manifest.title: Investigate current placement constraints
manifest.purpose: Explain observed placement restrictions separately from resource usage and vertical eligibility.

baseline: Fresh complete scoped inventory with exact cluster, Namespace, Pod and controller UIDs
guarded: Fresh complete scoped inventory with exact cluster, Namespace, Pod and controller UIDs

limitations: Current metadata is not historical scheduling behavior, a packing simulation or proof of stranded capacity.
Projected labels cannot prove selector matches or absence. Namespace PDB candidates are not matched budgets.
Tolerations permit placement but do not require it. Soft preferences are distinct from hard constraints.
Volume bindings, CSI topology, Pod/IP slots, priority/preemption, daemon requests and availability need independent review.
prerequisites: Review the admitted Pod, matching node labels/taints, volume topology and actual PDB selectors with its owner.
risks: Relaxing affinity, topology, taints or disruption policy can violate isolation, availability or storage requirements.
validation: Correlate each observed restriction with approved pending-Pod history and scheduler capacity evidence.
Check daemon and init/sidecar overhead, Pod/IP slots, priorities, volumes and zonal failover before any packing claim.
Keep hard requirements and soft preferences separate; verify unknown fields rather than assuming absence.
rollback: No change is proposed. Any later owner-approved experiment requires a separate canary and exact configuration rollback.

baseline: Investigate current placement restrictions; do not remove nodes or relax policy from this report.
guarded: Investigate current placement restrictions; guarded mode does not authorize a scheduling change.

glossary.baseline: Qualified investigations only; no numeric resource or replica proposals.
glossary.guarded: Guarded mode is not approval. Numeric proposals require independent owner policy, complete identity-bound evidence, reliability gates and a one-dimensional canary/rollback. Configuration never enables owner opt-ins or changes a cluster.
glossary.coverage: Returned evaluation points, not proof of raw scrape completeness.
glossary.identity: Historical UIDs and exact Azure IDs; current names cannot backfill history.
glossary.unknown: Missing or unsupported evidence is not zero or proof of health.
glossary.query-only: Executable exports measure signals; they do not pass assessment gates.
glossary.provenance: Pack/query versions and digests bind replay, not source attestation.
glossary.mCPU: One thousandth of a CPU core.
glossary.MiB: 1,048,576 bytes; working set and full usage are distinct measurements.
glossary.ratio: Dimensionless fraction; not a universal utilization target.
glossary.events: Complete interval counts; missing intervals are not zero.
glossary.pods: Sampled replica counts, not availability or safe capacity by themselves.
glossary.boolean: Explicit observed state; missing observations remain unknown.

guarded_notice: Guarded mode is not approval. Numeric proposals require independent owner policy, complete identity-bound evidence, reliability gates and a one-dimensional canary/rollback. Configuration never enables owner opt-ins or changes a cluster.
